name: pain-point-statusline
description: After each turn, extracts the user's current pain point from the conversation and surfaces it in the status line.

interface.shortDescription: Show the user's current pain point at the status line
interface.longDescription: Adds a UserPromptSubmit hook that quietly asks Claude to judge the previous exchange's pain point in its own words (first-person, e.g. "I'm feeling frustrated") and record it via a one-line Bash call before addressing the new message — no blocking, no subprocess model call, no visible narration. A detected pain point stays displayed until a new one is actually detected; neutral turns don't clear it. Ships a statusline script that reads the resulting state file and renders it. Requires the user to point Claude Code's statusLine setting at scripts/statusline.mjs (plugins cannot register a status line directly) — see README.md.
